entries.build_command: bash runtime-netlink/build_one.sh before && bash runtime-netlink/build_one.sh after && bash runtime-netlink/build_cross_old.sh
entries.reachability_signal: headers_install layout markers prove the declaration changed; NETLINK_RUNTIME_RESULT for lo/IFLA_STATS proves the real rtnl_fill_stats reply path and records nla_len/payload_len; DONE success=1 is required for each VM.
entries.expected_signal: before native size/payload 96; after native size/payload 100 and new field offset 96; after-oldheader compiled size 96 sees payload 100, strict_old_accept=0, prefix_old_accept=1, native_exact=0.
entries.input_strategy: 使用相同 RTM_GETLINK dump 查询 lo 的 IFLA_STATS；分别运行 before native、after native，以及由 before headers 编译但运行在 after kernel 上的旧消费者，覆盖精确长度、兼容前缀和 native-size 控制。
entries.limitations: 结构声明不是 gcov 可执行行；32-bit compat 用户态未假定可用，需单独探测本机 multilib。未知/嵌套请求属性不控制本次 reply-only IFLA_STATS 布局变化。
